method.case_evaluation: Use latest observation received by open. Depot weather at local open date is a daily proxy. Later credible receipt is an outcome, censored at the split end.
method.cold_controls: First overdue checkpoint per newly credible A observation. Battery and deadline-date depot weather are available predictors. Next receipt is measured only as a later outcome. Controls may overlap selected cases.
method.deadline_selection: On development only, first tested deadline at least one hour above empirical p99 with zero healthy crossings.
method.healthy_cadence: Positive adjacent intervals under 30h with both batteries at least 25% and neither BX low flag. Assign by the latest required receipt.
method.recovery: Later-observed receipts only, by receipt order. Group outcomes by recovery receipt and report episodes still open at history end.

methodology.clock: Receipts enter on the inclusive snapshot boundary. Future-skewed observations are excluded. Observation order guards ignition, fault and plan transitions.
methodology.cluster: Choose a qualifying window of gap onsets within the maximum spread. New clusters require an onset within the last spread duration. Sustained clusters overlap their immediately prior window.
methodology.cohort: Eligible ignition-on T trackers grouped by carrier and depot. Depot follows known VIN evidence when available. No end-of-history status filter.
methodology.contrast: The selection grid requires at least three timely eligible trackers and at least half of the eligible other-carrier cohort in the same depot. The off-grid contrast sweep keeps the selected driving and outage parameters fixed and does not change selection.
methodology.fragmentation: A labelled fragment is a run of consecutive detected minutes in the label window. An episode is a consecutive run per carrier/depot in the unguarded background.
methodology.gap: Driving is overdue strictly after latest driving evidence plus the candidate delay. Equality stays timely. An uninterrupted overdue run keeps its first onset through stale backfill. Observed ignition-off, power loss and inactive plans remove the device from its cohort.
methodology.label_use: Support case carrier, depot, open and close times only grade the snapshots. Guarded minutes around labels are omitted from background volume. Background counts are unlabelled alerts, not verified false positives.
methodology.limits: These snapshots measure a driving tracker seed and initial detection. Runtime incident continuation and recovery, compatible camera and daily/parked memberships, full replacement ownership, and location dispersion require later validation.
methodology.selection: Rank on development only by more label matches, fewer background episodes and snapshots, fewer label fragments and earlier detection. Exact ties favor the prior kit's center values. Validation is reported unchanged.

method.camera_cohort: Conservative same-asset pairing uses one rostered tracker with ignition events and no VIN contradiction visible before the slice end. Roster collisions are excluded from camera measurements. Recording gaps stay inside a confirmed drive and reset on non-recording status or plan transitions.
method.limits: Estimates apply to observed, deduplicated sample gaps and conservative retrospective pairing. Some forecast deadlines include unclassified real interruptions. Camera wake delays with no observation have no point estimate.
method.position_and_heartbeat: Positive gaps within one explicit ignition mode, reset on mode changes or disconnect. Only true-ignition positions enter driving cadence. Gaps are assigned by the latest supporting first receipt.
method.quantiles: Nearest rank, with the sample size for each measure.
method.reboot: Deduplicated commands enter the response cohort only with awake tracker context and an unresolved storage error already visible when the command was received. A later recording is an outcome and does not prove the reboot caused it. No support case outcomes are used.
method.sensitivity: Late cadence gaps use >. Transition and reboot thresholds use the availability delay <= and classify insufficient follow-up as right-censored. Follow-up ends at an ignition mode change, another reboot for reboot trials, or the end of the receipt slice. An absent recording can reflect a real break, an outage, or another cause.
method.transitions: Use the first post-ignition recorded observation or first usable receipt, measured from ignition observation time. A transition cohort is assigned by ignition receipt. Observation and receipt summaries can use different reports after out-of-order delivery.
